facts.value: The Unibator serves as an 'incubator for innovation' at Goethe University, supporting students, staff, and alumni from all disciplines in transforming scientific knowledge and emerging business ideas into market-ready products and services. Founders participate in an 18-month startup program aimed at developing a validated and scalable business model.
The AndersGründer project in the Social Impact Lab Frankfurt accompanies startups in founding their social enterprises, providing coaching, qualification, co-working, and access to relevant networks.

Universities in the FrankfurtRheinMain area are enhancing their collaboration and centralizing their efforts in a single internet portal to support startup initiatives from the academic environment, providing information on incubators and accelerators, funding program consultation, cooperation offers with external partners from business and academia, competitions, and startup awards.
Interdisciplinary and intercollegiate team formation opportunities are also available.
